name: nanobox
description: Linux in the browser: container2wasm/Bochs engine rebuilt with a trace JIT (memory-identical guest RAM), plus 'system node on the browser V8' sandbox pages (Claude Code / codex / agy installed from the vendors at first run). Also the CheerpX experiment (server.mjs).

scripts.test: npm run -s test:unit && npm run -s test:engine && npm run -s test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test "test/*.test.js" && node test/wasifs-write-unit.mjs && node test/installer-unit.mjs && node test/bunfs-unit.mjs && node test/bun-globals-unit.mjs && node test/jit-host-unit.mjs && (cd guest/nbnode && ./build.sh test)
scripts.test:engine: npm run -s test:identity && npm run -s test:gate && npm run -s test:bundle-roundtrip && npm run -s test:checkpoint && npm run -s test:nbnode-rpc
scripts.test:nbnode-rpc: cd harness && node run.mjs ../build/eh-nb/out.wasm --oci http://localhost:8093/c2w/images/codex/ --spec ../test/hc-test-spec.json --oci-cache ../work/oci-cache --bundle-file nb/node=../guest/nbnode/nbnode --cmd '/bin/sh -c "exec /bundle/nb/node cli.js --arg1"' --nbnode-test --timeout 25
scripts.test:e2e: npm run -s test:e2e-codex && npm run -s test:e2e-agy && npm run -s test:e2e-claude && npm run -s test:e2e-native && npm run -s test:e2e-native-vm && npm run -s test:e2e-sandbox && npm run -s test:e2e-claude-tui && npm run -s test:e2e-typing && npm run -s test:e2e-codex-login
scripts.test:e2e-sandbox: node test/e2e-sandbox.mjs --cli claude && node test/e2e-sandbox.mjs --cli codex && node test/e2e-sandbox.mjs --cli agy
scripts.test:e2e-orig-record: node test/e2e.mjs codex --engine orig --record && node test/e2e.mjs agy --engine orig --record && node test/e2e.mjs claude --engine orig --record
